title: Finite independent differential families remain independent in a geometrically regular local algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $(A,\mathfrak m,K)$ be a Noetherian local $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with $K=A/\mathfrak m$, and suppose $A$ is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. For every finite index set $I$ and family $(a_i)_{i\in I}$ in $k$, if $(\mathrm da_i)_{i\in I}$ is linearly independent over $k$ in $\Omega_{k/\mathbf F_p}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], then $(1\otimes\mathrm d(a_i\cdot1_A))_{i\in I}$ is linearly independent over $K$ in $K\otimes_A\Omega_{A/\mathbf F_p}$. The $\mathbf F_p$-algebra structure on $A$ is the composite through $k$. The empty family is included.

proof.text: Enumerate the finite index type by Fin n using Fintype.equivFin, and pull back the given independent differential family along the enumeration.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-residue-differentials] to the coefficient images in A. Obtain the actual local p-root quotient B, its local coefficient map, the residue field L, the span description of ker beta and dim coker beta=n.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-residue-dimension-balance] to geometric regularity and the enumerated independent base-field family. Substitute the kernel span and cokernel dimension into its equality. linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span now proves that the displayed n vectors are L-linearly independent.

The local coefficient map induces the field extension K=ResidueField A → L=ResidueField B. Construct the K-linear tensor map f with AlgebraTensorModule.map applied to Algebra.linearMap K L and the identity on Omega[A/F_p]. Restrict L-linear independence to K using LinearIndependent.restrict_scalars′, then descend along f with LinearIndependent.of_comp. The map sends 1 tensor da_i to 1 tensor da_i because the field map preserves 1. Reindex back using linearIndependent_equiv. The same proof covers the empty family.
